tasks.short: Start aircraft and observe instruments for malfunctions

steps.what: Read actual aircraft status, applicable inspection instructions and instrument references using native aircraft and revision filters
inputs: Actual aircraft status and current inspection instructions
outputs: Verified aircraft and instruction context in the aviation inspection system

steps.what: Confirm actual immediate aircraft-start readiness, real delegated operating authority and current aircraft and surrounding conditions
inputs: Actual applicable instructions and operating authority
outputs: Current decision to proceed with the specified aircraft start or stop

steps.what: Actually start the aircraft under the current authorised inspection procedure
outputs: Actual aircraft start and observed operating state

steps.what: Observe actual gauges, meters and other instruments to detect evidence of malfunctions and capture actual observations
inputs: Actual aircraft operating state and instrument indications
outputs: Actual instrument observations and human malfunction findings

steps.what: Write and check the actual inspection entry using native reuse of the verified aircraft identifier
outputs: Completed actual inspection entry

steps.what: Save the actual inspection entry in the same workspace
outputs: Saved actual entry

tasks.design: Use native aircraft and instruction views in {OPS_SYSTEM} and {DOCS}. Retain actual aircraft-start readiness, physical starting and instrument observation, then separately write the actual inspection entry with exact aircraft context.
tasks.previous_blocker: Aircraft context is repeatedly located and identifiers recopied into actual inspection records.
tasks.enabler_now: Native views and record context can reduce those clerical operations.
tasks.still_hard: Actual operating conditions, instrument behaviour and malfunction evidence require direct human attention.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise abnormal indications and act within the actual inspection procedure and authority.

ambition.what: No autonomous aircraft operation or additional inspection capacity is assumed.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-5 to inspect actual aviation records and operating authority

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native aircraft record views can reduce clerical handling while aircraft starting and instrument-based malfunction assessment remain human.

assumptions: Representative authorised inspection start with an actual required inspection entry. Maintenance and procedure owners produce actual status and instructions in ordinary work; focal reading and verification remain in s1. No new serviceable-aircraft assertion is supplied for free.

s2 is actual current physical-operation readiness, not author self-approval of paperwork. a1 applies only to the specified start under actual current conditions and authority; any condition or instruction change invalidates it. No operating instructions or controls are generated or automated.

s4 counts actual observation and finding capture; s5 separately counts actual record writing and checking. Only the aircraft identifier verified in s1 is reused. No clean instrument feed or inferred completed test is assumed.

Use native features first; existing views and fields give no new gain. If no actual entry is required, remove it and measure the real work rather than inventing a report. Airworthiness release, repair instructions or notices are distinct real actions if required, not hidden in this entry.

Ordinary same-system save is ungated with no self-approval or saving. Provisional shares ignore the prior. Gross 15*0.10+14*0.10=2.9; upkeep 1 leaves net 1.9. Retained s1-s5 labour is 96.1 already counted. Save share 1 is the integer minimum for negligible effort, fully retained.
unknowns: Actual start authority and inspection record process
research_questions: Observe an actual authorised inspection start and separate record lookup, readiness, physical operation, observation and written entry.

already_counted.description: Instruction reading, actual readiness, aircraft start, instrument observation and actual inspection writing remain in s1-s5.

incremental.description: Maintain native aircraft views and identifier context beyond ordinary inspection checks.

approvals.approved_version: The specified aircraft start under actual current conditions, applicable instructions and operating authority; any change requires fresh readiness

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Upper bound needs repeated instruction navigation and aircraft-identifier entry. If native inspection tools already remove both, no additional saving or new upkeep is incurred. Actual operation and observation remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Recommend aviation rule and policy changes

steps.what: Read actual operating-condition evidence, aircraft improvement records and current rule or policy versions using native subject and revision filters
inputs: Existing operating evidence and aircraft improvement records
outputs: Verified recommendation context and exact references

steps.what: Recommend changes in aviation rules, policies, standards or regulations based on actual operating conditions, aircraft improvements and relevant evidence
outputs: Human recommendation and supporting rationale with limitations

steps.what: Write and check the actual recommendation brief, reusing exact verified evidence and rule references
outputs: Completed checked recommendation brief

steps.what: Save the recommendation brief in its existing workspace
outputs: Saved brief

steps.what: Actually explain the proposed changes and evidence to internal policy colleagues in the normal spoken consultation
outputs: Actual recommendation discussion and clarified questions

tasks.design: Use native subject and revision views in {DOCS} and the aviation record system, {OPS_SYSTEM}. The inspector develops the actual policy recommendation, separately writes the brief and discusses it with the actual policy colleagues.
tasks.previous_blocker: Evidence and rule references are repeatedly located and copied into recommendation briefs.
tasks.enabler_now: Native views and exact reference links can reduce repeated handling.
tasks.still_hard: The consequences of proposed aviation changes require expert assessment of real evidence.
tasks.human_edge: Explain why a proposed change fits actual conditions and what remains uncertain.

ambition.what: No automatic rule change or greater policy authority is assumed.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-4 to inspect actual evidence access and recommendation channels

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native revision views and exact reference reuse can assist policy recommendation briefs while substantive aviation policy judgement remains human.

assumptions: Representative recommendation-development episode with an actual brief and internal spoken consultation. Operating and engineering staff produce existing evidence and policy owners current rules during ordinary work; focal reading remains in s1 and actual recommendation development in s2.

s3 separately counts the actual brief and all checking, reusing only verified references. No clean policy-impact feed, free transcript or automatic recommendation is assumed. Missing evidence requires manual investigation.
Native functionality comes first; existing views and links yield no new gain. Do not invent a brief after every informal policy conversation if actual work has none.

s5 is actual spoken consultation, not a hidden filing or external send. Formal proposals, public consultation, rule adoption and publication require their actual work and final-version authority if included. Ordinary save is ungated with no author self-approval or saving.

Provisional shares ignore the prior. Gross 20*0.10+24*0.20=6.8; upkeep 2 leaves net 4.8. Retained s1,s2,s3,s5 labour is 92.2 already counted. Save share 1 is the minimum integer representation of negligible effort, fully retained.
unknowns: Actual recommendation and formal filing channels
Existing evidence and rule reference tools
research_questions: Trace an actual aviation policy recommendation from original evidence to its brief and actual consultation.

already_counted.description: Evidence reading, actual policy recommendation, brief writing and real consultation remain in s1,s2,s3,s5.

incremental.description: Maintain revision views and source links beyond ordinary recommendation checks.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Upper bound needs repeated source navigation and reference copying. Existing native tools that already handle both leave no additional saving or new upkeep. Actual policy reasoning and consultation remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Investigate the actual air accident or complaint through original evidence examination, site work and interviews; capture observations and accounts
inputs: Actual accident or complaint and original evidence
Actual witnesses and site access under existing investigation authority
outputs: Actual investigation observations, accounts and contemporaneous notes

steps.what: Verify and enter actual evidence identifiers, original timestamp text, explicitly known time basis and source references into the working evidence inventory
inputs: Original evidence and actual notes from s1
outputs: Checked entered evidence inventory with uncertain times marked in the investigation case system

steps.what: Sort exact explicitly comparable timestamps and link each chronology item to its entered original evidence identifier
inputs: Checked evidence inventory and explicit time bases from s2
outputs: Literal chronology with uncertain or incomparable times segregated, without causal conclusions

steps.what: Determine causes from original accident or complaint evidence, test alternative explanations and check chronology limitations
outputs: Human causal findings and unresolved alternatives

steps.what: Write and check the actual working causal-finding entry with its supporting evidence and uncertainty
inputs: Actual human findings and original supporting evidence
outputs: Completed working finding entry

steps.what: Save the working finding in its existing restricted workspace
outputs: Saved working finding

tasks.design: Keep original evidence examination, interviews and causal analysis human. In the investigation case system, {OPS_SYSTEM}, sort only explicitly comparable timestamps entered by the inspector, then record actual findings in {DOCS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Investigators manually reorder already verified timestamped evidence in a working chronology.
tasks.enabler_now: Native sorting and source links can repeat literal ordering without inferring event times or causes.
tasks.still_hard: Evidence reliability, missing events and causal alternatives require actual investigation.
tasks.human_edge: Distinguish temporal order from causation and preserve unresolved explanations.

ambition.what: No faster physical investigation or automatic causal decision is assumed.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-5 to inspect actual evidence handling and restricted access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native sorting of explicitly comparable timestamps can assist evidence chronology while accident and complaint causation remains human investigation.

assumptions: Representative investigation phase with actual timestamped evidence, a working inventory and working findings. Witnesses and source systems produce original accounts and records; actual evidence collection, interviews and note capture are fully counted in s1. No digital evidence package is supplied for free.

s2 fully counts verification and entry of every identifier, timestamp, known time basis and source reference used by s3. Uncertain times remain uncertain; no automatic reconstruction, transcription or unverified timezone conversion occurs.
s3 sorts only comparable entered times. s4 retains original-source checking and all causal judgement. Use native case-system sorting first; already native chronology yields no new gain.

s5 is an actual working finding, not an invented full report after every interview. Formal accident reporting, complainant replies, public release or evidence transfers need their own real work and authority if included. This estimate cannot be extrapolated to those tasks or to an unobserved complete investigation mix.

Ordinary same-system save is ungated with no self-approval or saving. Provisional shares ignore the prior. Gross 10; upkeep 3 leaves net 7. Retained s1,s2,s4,s5 labour is 89 already counted. Save share 1 is the minimum integer representation of negligible effort, fully retained.
unknowns: Actual chronology workload and native sorting
Evidence comparability and formal reporting requirements
research_questions: Inspect one actual case chronology and distinguish timestamp verification and evidence capture from literal reordering and causal analysis.

already_counted.description: Actual evidence collection, inventory capture, causal analysis and working finding writing remain in s1,s2,s4,s5.

incremental.description: Maintain chronology input rules and source-link tests beyond ordinary evidence checking.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Upper bound removes 10 points of actual manual ordering after full timestamp verification. If native case tools already order these items, no new reduction or configuration upkeep is incurred. Evidence collection and causal judgement remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Analyze aviation training and examine actual competence

steps.what: Read actual training programs, competency requirements and candidate records using native program and version filters
inputs: Actual training material and candidate records
outputs: Verified examination and program context

steps.what: Analyze actual aviation-equipment training programs against competency needs and original requirements
inputs: Original training program and actual requirements
outputs: Human program analysis and actual examination focus

steps.what: Prepare and check the actual oral and written examination material and criteria for the operating, installing or repairing competence being examined
inputs: Existing authorised examination material where applicable
outputs: Actual checked examination material and criteria

steps.what: Conduct the actual oral examination, question the candidate and observe the responses
outputs: Actual oral responses and examination observations

steps.what: Conduct the actual written examination under existing examination arrangements and collect actual candidate answers
inputs: Actual candidate and written examination material
outputs: Actual written answers and administration observations

steps.what: Evaluate original oral and written evidence against actual criteria to determine the examined person's demonstrated competence
outputs: Human examination findings and limits

steps.what: Write and check the actual examination working record after examination and assessment have occurred
inputs: Actual examination events and human findings
outputs: Completed actual examination working record

steps.what: Save the actual working record in its existing workspace without issuing certification
outputs: Saved working record

tasks.design: Use native program and revision views in {LMS} and original requirements in {DOCS}. Retain training analysis, examination preparation, actual oral and written examinations and human competence assessment, then separately write the actual working record.
tasks.previous_blocker: Current program and candidate context is repeatedly located before actual analysis and examination.
tasks.enabler_now: Native views can reduce navigation without assessing competence.
tasks.still_hard: Valid examinations and interpreting actual candidate evidence require expert judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Determine what the person actually demonstrates within the examination's limits.

ambition.what: No automated competence decision or extra examination capacity is assumed.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-4 to inspect actual examination permissions and records

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native training-program views can reduce lookup while examination conduct and competence assessment remain human.

assumptions: Representative program-analysis and examination episode. Training staff produce actual programs and records in ordinary work; focal reading is counted in s1, program analysis in s2 and genuine examination preparation in s3. Do not charge recurring examination-bank development to every candidate; use this estimate only where actual preparation occurs.

s4-s5 count actual oral and written administration and original answer capture. s6 retains all original evidence assessment, with no automatic grade, competence, cheating or behaviour inference. No clean candidate-answer feed or free transcript is assumed.

s7 separately counts actual post-examination writing and checking. Completion and findings are based only on actual events. If no separate working record is required, remove it and measure the actual process rather than inventing a report.

Use native views first; existing program filters yield no new gain. Certification, licence change, formal result issue or notices require their actual final-version authority and distinct actions if included. Ordinary same-system save does not issue certification and is ungated with no author self-approval or saving.

Provisional shares ignore the prior. Gross 20*0.10=2; upkeep 1 leaves net 1. Retained s1-s7 labour is 97 already counted. Save share 1 is the minimum integer representation of negligible effort, fully retained.
unknowns: Actual examination preparation and certification workflow
research_questions: Observe an actual program review and examination and distinguish preparation, administration, assessment, working records and formal certification.

already_counted.description: Source reading, program analysis, actual preparation, oral and written conduct, human assessment and real record writing remain in s1-s7.

incremental.description: Maintain program and candidate views beyond ordinary examination checks.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Upper bound reduces repeated program-context navigation only. If current native views already provide it, no additional gain or configuration upkeep is incurred. Actual analysis, examination and competence assessment remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

reach: Aircraft and procedure owners supplying actual operating context
Training staff and actual examination candidates
skills_to_grow: Direct instrument observation and real operating authority discipline
Careful timestamp provenance and causal investigation
Valid examinations and accurate post-event records
role.ambitious_version: An aviation inspector who handles verified records efficiently while retaining direct observation, operational readiness, causal investigation and human competence assessment.
